automations.title: Backlink discovery, verification and reclamation
automations.note: Runs without any connector or secret. Reads every placement in backlinks/ledger.json off the live web, records the real link attributes, commits the register to main, and opens a labelled issue when a link is lost or stops passing equity. Optional Search Console secrets widen discovery only.
